Manufactured by [[GoCorp/Legends|GoCorp]], the '''CD-14c Gunner droid brain''' was a [[Starship/Legends|shipboard]] droid brain similar to the corporation's [[CD-12a autopilot droid brain]].<ref name="SM">''[[Special Modifications]]''</ref>

Designed to be installed on a ship to assist [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] gunners or to operate weapon systems independently, the CD-14c was popular with those who wanted their ship to defend itself when necessary<ref name="SM" /> Despite its popularity, some owners complained about the brain's overly antagonistic and hostile behavior.<ref name="SM" />
